comment: Pinned relocatable CPython (python-build-standalone, file 10 §3.1). sha256 is filled by `node scripts/fetch-pyruntime.mjs --write-lock` on a networked runner and committed; CI `--verify` fails on any empty sha256 (supply-chain gate, §3.1/§10).
comment_keys: Target keys MATCH electron-builder's ${os}-${arch} file macro (mac/linux/windows) so electron-builder.yml extraResources `from: ../../staging/pyruntime/${os}-${arch}` resolves the runtime this script stages (APP-068 — both sides verified consistent).
comment_windows_arm64: Dropped: python-build-standalone release 20240909 has no aarch64-pc-windows-msvc install_only asset (404). Windows ARM64 packaging is x64-only for now (electron-builder.yml win target); re-add with a newer CPython release that publishes the win-arm64 triple (APP-068).
